commentary: Market breadth is severely compromised at 34% alongside a WEAK deterministic gate as the Nifty plunges 1.64% under heavy institutional selling. William O'Neil and Stan Weinstein taught that three out of four equities inevitably succumb to general market direction; initiating aggressive risk during confirmed distribution days invites needless drawdown. Jesse Livermore's discipline requires respecting the general tape by sitting tight in high cash reserves. While resilient Stage 2 candidates with accelerating CANSLIM earnings display commendable relative strength, Mark Minervini's progressive exposure rules dictate extreme caution. Keep position sizing fractional, avoid chasing pivots, and cut losses unconditionally at pre-set stops.

analysis.analyst: Minervini SEPA, O'Neil CANSLIM & Weinstein Stage Analysis

AAREYDRUGS.technical: Holding above its 21 EMA, 50 SMA, and 200 SMA within 1.5% of its 20-session pivot on double volume. However, the pattern lacks a multi-stage VCP contraction, and relative strength is questionable against wider market distribution.
AAREYDRUGS.fundamental: Operating profit margins are compressed below 3%, with poor 3-year average ROE of 3.4% and an erratic earnings record. Balance sheet metrics and absent institutional sponsorship fail CANSLIM investment thresholds.
AAREYDRUGS.risk: Thesis breaks below the 100.37 stop loss. Minervini mandates cutting losses immediately without hoping or averaging down.

ADANIGREEN.technical: Cleared its 20-session high on exceptional 4.16× average volume, well above rising 21 EMA, 50 SMA, and 200 SMA. RSI at 62 confirms constructive momentum, though overhead tape weakness creates retest risk.
ADANIGREEN.fundamental: Operational capacity expanded 27% to 20.1 GW with EBITDA margins above 85%. However, quarterly EPS growth decelerated below 25%, while elevated debt leverage and modest ROCE (~7.4%) restrict leadership qualification.
ADANIGREEN.risk: Hard stop at 1552.30. A failure back inside the base signals an institutional bull trap requiring immediate liquidation.

ADFFOODS.technical: Forming a constructive double-bottom base above rising 21 EMA, 50 SMA, and 200 SMA. Right-side accumulation is verified by 1.67× volume and an RSI of 71, exhibiting strong relative strength versus falling benchmarks.
ADFFOODS.fundamental: Maintains an unleveraged balance sheet with net cash, healthy ROCE of 22%, and resilient operating margins of 18%. Nevertheless, recent EPS YoY growth sits below 25%, missing CANSLIM acceleration criteria.
ADFFOODS.risk: Invalidation occurs if price breaks below 302.23. Honor hard stop discipline immediately to prevent severe capital loss.

AEGISLOG.technical: Textbook double bottom breakout above rising 21 EMA, 50 SMA, and 200 SMA on 1.74× average volume. RSI at 57 reflects steady accumulation without overextension, showing powerful relative strength in a weak tape.
AEGISLOG.fundamental: Exemplary CANSLIM fundamentals. LPG volumes surged 91% YoY, lifting EBITDA by 184% and profit by 212%. Operating margins expanded to record highs alongside strong cash generation and Project GATI capex execution.
AEGISLOG.risk: Setup is invalidated on a close below 1386.46. Cut losses quickly if volume dries up and the pivot fails.

AEROFLEX.technical: Displays decisive Stage 2 double-bottom leadership, trading well above 21 EMA, 50 SMA, and 200 SMA. Strong lower wicks demonstrate institutional absorption at key swing lows, supported by positive MACD expansion.
AEROFLEX.fundamental: Classic CANSLIM profile. Topline revenue surged 72% YoY while net profit jumped 162% with robust 23% operating margins. Strong ROCE of 19% and virtually debt-free balance sheet support rapid export capacity expansion.
AEROFLEX.risk: Breach below 535.29 destroys the pattern structure. Apply strict Minervini stop loss execution without hesitation.

AETHER.technical: Consolidating tightly within 1.5% of its 20-session pivot, strictly above upward-trending 21 EMA, 50 SMA, and 200 SMA. RSI at 71 reveals elite relative strength against benchmark breakdown pressure.
AETHER.fundamental: Specialty chemical leader exhibits steady margin expansion to 31% and steady volume recovery. Balance sheet leverage remains minimal with ROCE around 16%, though EPS growth remains slightly under the 25% CANSLIM standard.
AETHER.risk: Thesis invalidates if price penetrates below 1688.21. Exit position promptly to protect trading capital in volatile conditions.
